templates.name: Follow-up after a support call
templates.body:
Hi [Customer Name],

Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today about [Issue]. As discussed, the next step is [Next Step], and I'll get back to you by [Date].

If anything changes in the meantime, just reply to this message.

Best regards,
[Your Name]

templates.name: Ask for more details
templates.body:
Hi [Customer Name],

To look into this properly I need a bit more information:

1. What exactly happened, and what did you expect to happen?
2. When did it start?
3. A screenshot or the exact error message, if you have one.

Thanks,
[Your Name]

templates.name: Issue resolved
templates.body:
Hi [Customer Name],

Good news: the problem with [Issue] has been fixed. The cause was [Cause], and we [Fix].

Please let me know if you see anything unexpected.

Best regards,
[Your Name]

templates.name: Code review prompt
templates.body:
Review the following [Language] code for bugs, readability and performance. List problems in order of severity and suggest a concrete fix for each. Do not rewrite the whole file.

[Paste Code]

templates.name: Summarize for an audience
templates.body:
Summarize the text below for [Audience] in [Length] sentences. Keep the key decisions and action items, and skip background they already know.

[Paste Text]

templates.name: Write a bug report
templates.body:
When writing a bug report, always include:

- Title: one line, starting with the area affected ([Area])
- Steps to reproduce, numbered
- Actual result vs. expected result
- Environment: [Environment]
- Evidence: logs, screenshots or a request ID

Keep it factual. No guessing at root causes unless labelled as a hypothesis.

templates.name: Write a commit message
templates.body: Write commit messages in the imperative mood with a subject under 72 characters, e.g. "Add retry to [Component]". Use the body to explain why the change was needed, not what the diff already shows.

templates.name: Set up a new development machine
templates.body:
1. Install Git and configure your name and email.
2. Install [Runtime] and your editor.
3. Clone [Repository] and run the setup script.
4. Sign in to [Service] and copy the shared config.
5. Run the tests to confirm everything works.
